issues.title: When we select an icon, any filters are lost
issues.body:
In the PlanningChannel we have the two lists of forces.

We can filter for things, including platform-type.

But, the filter is lost when an asset is selected, either from the table or the map.

I _guess_ we need to cache the filter settings, then update the rows, then apply the settings again.

Hmm, the drop-downs probably only need to be generated once - since the assets essentially stay in the game.  So, may just declare the columns once - and just do the rows afterwards?

Yes THAT'S THE FIX!
